episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Sky Original drama following the true story of seemingly ordinary couple Susan and Christopher Edwards, who find themselves the focus of a murder inquiry.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: As the investigation into the Mansfield double murder continues, Susan and Chris's past is revealed and secrets emerge.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Christopher opens up about his past as the couple's relationship with Susan's parents comes under the spotlight. Lancing and Wilkie have a breakthrough.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Truth and fantasy clash as Susan and Christopher Edwards face trial. Meeting for the first time since their arrest, old doubts and new regrets test their love.
